page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supporting AVX and AVX-512F instructions. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff. Single-core CPU performance is weak, scoring in the bottom 25% on stress-ng and Geekbench, with single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by middle-50% scores in stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads and writes also performs in the average tier.

Given the high memory density and average multi-core scaling alongside weaker single-threaded execution, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-core clock speeds. It is suitable for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks such as software compilation or medium-sized LLM inference.
